name: T_macro
description: Row-stochastic species transfer operator fit in retained/coarse macrocluster space.

name: evals
description: Leading non-stationary eigenvalues of T_macro; evals[0] is lambda_2 because lambda_1 was dropped.

name: evecs_macro
description: Right eigenvectors of T_macro matching evals; columns begin with phi_2/lambda_2.

name: phi_macro_native
description: Native slow eigenspace coordinates from species T_macro eigenvectors; columns are phi_2 onward.

name: phi_macro_shared
description: Species macroclusters projected into the pooled/shared reference eigenspace.

name: pi_macro
description: Stationary distribution over macroclusters for T_macro; sums to approximately 1.

name: macro_occupancy
description: Empirical occupancy over macroclusters after low-occupancy absorption; sums to approximately 1.

name: chi_macro
description: Species-native GPCCA soft arm memberships for macroclusters; rows sum to approximately 1.

name: chi_macro_aligned
description: GPCCA macrocluster arm memberships after Hungarian alignment across species.

name: arm_assignments_macro
description: Species-native hard GPCCA arm assignment for each macrocluster, zero-indexed.

name: arm_assignments_macro_aligned
description: Hungarian-aligned hard arm assignment for each macrocluster, zero-indexed; -1 means unavailable.

name: active_global_clusters
description: Original global cluster IDs retained before absorption/coarse graining when available.

name: absorption_weights
description: Matrix W mapping original global clusters to macroclusters; shape is K_global x K_macro.

name: pi_global
description: Stationary macro pi lifted back to original global cluster space with occupancy-share weights; sums to approximately 1.

name: occupancy_global
description: Empirical macro occupancy lifted back to original global cluster space; use for repertoire/background weighting.

name: chi_global
description: Species-native GPCCA arm memberships lifted back to original global cluster space.

name: chi_global_aligned
description: Hungarian-aligned arm memberships lifted back to original global cluster space; best for cross-species relaxation-mode interpretation.

name: phi_global_native
description: Species-native slow coordinates lifted back to original global cluster space.

name: phi_global_shared
description: Shared-reference slow coordinates lifted back to original global cluster space.

name: arm_assignments_global_aligned
description: Dominant Hungarian-aligned arm for each original global cluster, zero-indexed; -1 means unavailable.
